camel_example: aliyun rds CreateMigrateTask --region cn-hangzhou --IsOnlineDB True --DBInstanceId 'rm-uf6wjk50000' --BackupMode FULL --DBName testDB
description_en: Restores a self-managed SQL Server backup file from Object Storage Service (OSS) to an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance to migrate data to the cloud
description_zh: 该接口用于将OSS上的自建SQL Server备份文件还原到RDS SQL Server实例，实现数据上云
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-migrate-task --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --db-name testDB --backup-mode FULL --is-online-db True --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMigrateTask

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the destination database
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the cloud migration task. Valid values:
FULL: performs a restore operation by using a full backup file. This value is applicable to first-time migrations or full data recovery scenarios.
UPDF: restores incremental data by using an incremental backup file or log file. This value is applicable to incremental synchronization scenarios based on an existing full backup
parameters.help_zh:
迁移上云任务类型，取值：
FULL：通过全量备份文件执行还原操作，适用于首次迁移或完整数据恢复的场景。
UPDF：通过增量备份文件或日志文件还原增量数据，适用于已有全量备份的基础上进行增量同步的场景
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to bring the restored database online so that users can access it. Valid values:

True: Brings the database online.
False: Does not bring the database online.

For SQL Server 2008 R2, this value is always True.
When IsOnlineDB is set to True, BackupMode must be set to FULL.
When IsOnlineDB is set to False, BackupMode must be set to UPDF
parameters.help_zh:
是否将还原后的数据库带上线，便于用户访问，取值：

True：将数据库带上线。
False：不将数据库带上线。

SQL Server 2008 R2版本该值恒定为True。
IsOnlineDB=True时，BackupMode必须为FULL。
IsOnlineDB=False时，BackupMode必须为UPDF
parameters.name: is_online_db

parameters.help_en:
The consistency check method after the database is brought online. This parameter takes effect only when IsOnlineDB is set to True. Valid values:

SyncExecuteDBCheck: synchronously performs a database check. This value is applicable to scenarios that require high data consistency.
AsyncExecuteDBCheck: asynchronously performs a database check. This value provides higher performance but may delay the detection of potential issues.

Default value: AsyncExecuteDBCheck (compatible with SQL Server 2008 R2)
parameters.help_zh:
打开数据库后的一致性检查方法，仅当IsOnlineDB=True时生效。取值：

SyncExecuteDBCheck：同步执行DB检查，适用于对数据一致性要求较高的场景。
AsyncExecuteDBCheck：异步执行DB检查，性能更高，但可能延迟发现潜在问题。

默认值为AsyncExecuteDBCheck（兼容SQL Server 2008 R2）
parameters.name: check_db_mode

parameters.help_en:
The information about the OSS file. The value consists of the following three parts separated by colons (:):
OSS endpoint: oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com.
OSS bucket name: rdsmssqlsingapore.
Backup file name on OSS: autotest_2008R2_TestMigration_FULL.bak.

This parameter is required for SQL Server versions later than SQL Server 2008 R2
parameters.help_zh:
OSS文件的组成部分，由以下三部分组成，并用英文冒号（:）分隔：
OSS Endpoint地址：oss-ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com。
OSS Bucket名称：rdsmssqlsingapore。
OSS上的备份文件名：autotest_2008R2_TestMigration_FULL.bak。

对于SQL Server 2008 R2以上版本，必须传入该参数
parameters.name: oss_object_positions

parameters.help_en:
The shared URL of the backup file on OSS (URL-encoded). If multiple URLs exist, separate them with vertical bars (|) before encoding, and then pass the encoded value.

This parameter is required for SQL Server 2008 R2
parameters.help_zh:
备份文件所在OSS的共享URL地址（Encode编码后的URL）。当存在多个地址时，先使用“|”隔开，再编码后传入参数。

SQL Server 2008 R2必须传入该参数
parameters.name: oss_urls

parameters.help_en:
The migration task ID. Valid values:

When BackupMode is set to FULL, leave this parameter empty (compatible with SQL Server 2008 R2).
When BackupMode is set to UPDF, set this parameter to the ID of the corresponding FULL task. You can call DescribeMigrateTasks to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh:
迁移任务ID，取值：

BackupMode=FULL时，该值为空，无需填写。（兼容SQL Server 2008 R2）。
BackupMode=UPDF时，该值为对应FULL任务的ID，可调用DescribeMigrateTasks获取
parameters.name: migrate_task_id

BackupMode.description_en:
The type of the cloud migration task. Valid values:
FULL: performs a restore operation by using a full backup file.
UPDF: restores incremental data by using an incremental backup file or log file
BackupMode.description_zh:
迁移上云任务类型，返回值：
FULL：通过全量备份文件执行还原操作。
UPDF：通过增量备份文件或日志文件还原增量数据
